name: Grand Chariot
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)Dubbed "Absolute Carnage", Grand Chariot is a short-sword Teigu that, when activated, dons you in incredibly resilient full armor boosting physical prowess and granting free flight, plus a built-in spear. It rapidly drains stamina and energy. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
